title: Final Expectation Value
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the expectation value of B must be correctly stated as <B> = <B>_0 + λ<C>_0.

title: Ground State Expectation Values
description: Essential Criteria: The results for <x1>, <x2>, and <x3> must be correctly evaluated as <x1> = 0, <x2> = 0, and <x3> = -λ/(mω^2).

title: Perturbation Theory Application
description: Important Criteria: The application of perturbation theory to derive the first-order corrections must be clearly shown.

title: Operator Commutation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the commutation relation [B, A] leading to C must be correctly performed.

title: Completeness Assumption
description: Optional Criteria: The assumption of completeness for the eigenstates |k>^(0) should be mentioned to clarify the derivation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign errors in the perturbation terms or final results will lead to a deduction.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any inconsistencies in units throughout the calculations will result in a deduction.
